rules.applicability: prose outside URLs and numeric separators
rules.expected: Use one space after sentence punctuation and no accidental word concatenation.
Place currency symbols before the number unless an explicit local convention applies.

rules.applicability: ordinary prose; excludes official names and accepted acronyms
rules.expected: Do not use & in place of and except in approved names/acronyms.

rules.applicability: numbers, names, citations, labels, claims, dates, currencies, URLs, and acronyms
rules.expected: Protected source content must be preserved unless an approved change is provided.

rules.applicability: deliberate bold or italic source emphasis
font metadata is explicit or reliably inherited
rules.expected: Use Marsh Serif for display headlines and Noto Sans for supporting text; Georgia/Arial are fallbacks.

rules.applicability: excludes images and colors proven to originate in theme/layout/master
rules.expected: Use approved brand colors and do not create new colors.

rules.applicability: approved master logo assets are available
rules.expected: Use an approved Oliver Wyman endorsed lockup without distortion.

rules.applicability: geometry resolves against the slide canvas
rules.expected: Off-canvas working content is excluded from delivery readiness; partially clipped text requires review.

rules.applicability: intent is not resolved by supplied instructions
rules.expected: Classify alternatives as Needs decision rather than designer failures.
Use focused, legible, balanced layouts with clear hierarchy and generous whitespace.
